issues.where: the left rock stack, frames 2405 to 2412
issues.what: white spray shows up inside the rock's silhouette and grows frame by frame, cut off on a hard edge that follows the rock's outline. The rock reads as a hole in a matte, as if it turned transparent, and in playback it shows as a flashing white patch on the stone.
issues.fix: put the spray layer behind the rock, or hold the rock matte, so spray only shows around the edge and wraps it with soft, broken edges

issues.where: the left rock stack, frames 2404 to 2411
issues.what: the same spray-through-rock matte error is there. This sheet repeats the frames of set-B-01 shifted by one frame, so the error is in the shot itself, not in how one sheet was put together.
issues.fix: same fix: layer the spray correctly behind the rock and rebuild the rock alpha

issues.where: the whole frame with the camera held, over 6 s
issues.what: the place reads as a still picture. The clouds, the haze and the water falling from the arch do not visibly change in 6 s, and the large forms and the sky do not change at all. Only the foam on the foreground flat moves, and only a little.
issues.fix: drive the clouds at their own height and speed, let the stream fall and break into spray, and roll fresh sheets of water and foam across the flat

issues.where: the animal on the left cliff face and the small creatures in the midground
issues.what: the animal on the cliff keeps nearly the same pose for all 6 s and seems pinned to a vertical face with no footing, so it reads as a placed model. The midground creatures barely move, and none of them pause, turn or shift weight.
issues.fix: give the animal a ledge to stand on and real behaviour: shift its weight, turn its head, take a step. Make the midground creatures move out of step with each other

issues.where: the spray wall behind the rocks and the gulls
issues.what: the big spray curtain hardly changes over 12 frames, and the gull on the right stays in the same place. The wave reads as a backdrop rather than water hitting the shore with weight.
issues.fix: simulate the break so the spray rises, breaks apart and falls back, and give the gulls wingbeats and travel

issues.what: the ripples and foam marks move very little and evenly, which hints at a scrolling texture
issues.fix: use displacement and foam that come from the incoming swell
